name: Grand Prix de l'automobile Club de France

nar.text: The 5 a.m. start was delayed for half an hour due to heavy fog but still the drivers saw the road only badly as fog was lingering on the entire circuit.
Bablot, who had to start second, stalled twice and lost 2m30s, leaving Jörns and Esser to go before him.

Bablot, who had to start second, stalled twice and lost 2m30s, leaving Jörns and Esser to go before him.
Pope (Itala) did not finish the first lap when after 13 km at the first turn, a loud noise under the hood marked the end of the Itala when a bearing went in the engine.
Delpierre runs off the road at the Boves railway bridge and ends up in a ditch; crew unhurt, car out.
Boillot leads by four seconds from Goux; Chassagne third.
Jörns goes over the embankment at the grandstand turn; pushed to the pits with outside help, he must retire.
